name: systematics_iem_sl_z6
description: GALPROP IEM model grid (Ackermann et al. 2012, ApJ 750, 3), model 'SL_Z6_R30_T150_C2'. Replaces the baseline gas+ICS diffuse pair with this model's own gas_iem_sl_z6/ics_iem_sl_z6 templates; every other template unchanged. ANCHOR / VALIDATION model: identified with the existing analysis baseline GALDEF (Lorimer pulsar cosmic-ray sources, z_h=6 kpc, R=30 kpc halo radius, T_S=150 K HI spin temperature, E(B-V) cut 2 mag). Included as a consistency check -- its fit is expected to closely match baseline_rho2 -- NOT an independent excursion; exclude it when computing the systematic spread over this group.
